title: Shrimp and veggie fried rice
summary: A quick, mild fried rice with finely chopped shrimp, egg and veggies: a family dinner that's toddler-friendly.
texture: Soft cooked rice with small, tender pieces of shrimp, egg and vegetables. Chop the shrimp small.
ingredients: 4 oz raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/2 cup frozen peas and diced carrots
steps: Cook the shrimp in the oil in a nonstick pan for 2 to 3 minutes until pink and opaque all the way through. Remove and chop finely.
Add the peas and carrots and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until soft.
Push the vegetables aside, pour in the egg and scramble until fully set.
Add the rice and shrimp, stir-fry for 2 minutes until hot, and stir in the soy sauce if using. Cool before serving.
choking: Chop shrimp into very small pieces: whole shrimp are firm and rubbery.
Squash the peas with a fork for younger toddlers.

allergens.name: Shellfish
allergens.note: Shrimp is a shellfish, one of the top 9 allergens. If it's new, offer a small piece of plain cooked shrimp first and watch your child for 2 hours.

allergens.name: Soy (if using soy sauce)
allergens.note: Soy sauce contains soy and usually wheat. Leave it out if needed.

allergens.name: Wheat (if using soy sauce)
allergens.note: Most soy sauce contains wheat; tamari is a wheat-free option.

storage: Cool quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour. Keeps 1 day in the fridge. Reheat until steaming hot all the way through, then cool. Don't reheat rice more than once.
tips: Leftover rice from the day before works best: it fries without going mushy.
Toddlers still need very little salt, so keep soy sauce to a splash.
